data.desc: Catalyst Bancorp, Inc. (Nasdaq: CLST) is a Louisiana corporation and registered bank holding company for Catalyst Bank, its wholly-owned subsidiary, with $631.2 million in assets at September 30, 2026. Founded in 1922 as St. Landry Homestead Federal Savings Bank, Catalyst Bank has served the Acadiana region of south-central Louisiana for more than a century and recently expanded into southwest Louisiana through the acquisition of Lakeside Bank. Catalyst Bank offers commercial and retail banking products with a focus on fueling business and improving lives in the communities we serve.
